title: The composition law for $Rf_!$
statement:
Use the finite-level coefficient datum of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]: $k$ is a field, $\ell$ is a prime invertible in $k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ be separated finite-type morphisms between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $Rf_!$ denote the compact-support direct image of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], restricted to the category $\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)$ of pro-etale complexes with an etale-origin witness [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. These functors preserve the bounded-below etale-origin class. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(g\circ f)_!$$
of functors $\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)\to\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(S,\Lambda)$, independent of all compactification choices under the comparisons of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. Under the canonical identity and composition identifications it is the identity when $f$ or $g$ is an identity. For any third separated finite-type morphism $h:S\to T$ with $T$ a finite-type $k$-scheme, it is associative: the two composites $Rh_!Rg_!Rf_!\to R(hgf)_!$ agree after inserting the canonical associator.

proof.text: Use the already constructed canonical etale compact-support compositor, its identity comparisons and its associativity law from [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons], implemented by rightDerivedLowerShriekPlusCompIso and its two unit theorems and associativity theorem. This is the same proper/open compactification-tower construction, with its geometric and refinement-coherence work retained in that existing implementation, not a new arbitrary compositor. Absorb bounded-below compatibility into the specified compact-support site comparison [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison], giving the natural comparison between the two restricted compact-support functors.

source.place: Tags 0F7J and 0F7K; transported along the canonical site comparison

proof.text: The comparison inverse image is an equivalence from the bounded-below etale category onto the full etale-origin subcategory, by [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] and the definition [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. Its precomposition functor is fully faithful. The two preimageIso constructions defining originCompositionAmbient and originComposition are unique preimages of the fixed ordered originCompositionModel. Applying map_preimage identifies their components at every comparison object with that model. In the full-subcategory inclusion, absorb the bounded-below compatibility into originComparisonModel and cancel the adjacent isomorphisms. The resulting originComposition_model is exactly the usual comparison square for a transported compositor.

source.place: Tags 099R and 09AF; fully faithful transport and map_preimage calculation

proof.text: For each unit law precompose with the etale-origin equivalence and postcompose with the invertible comparison for the composite. Expand the transported compositor square and the transported identity square. The remaining equation is the corresponding etale unit law from [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons], together with naturality of the single-morphism comparison (left unit) or the transported identity (right unit). Equality transport is compatible with the comparison by substitution. Faithfulness reflects the resulting equation.

source.place: Tags 0F7J and 0F7K; transported along the canonical site comparison

proof.text: For associativity use the elementary private transport_assoc lemma, proved for arbitrary categories and functors. At each object cancel the final comparison isomorphism. Substitute the four compositor squares and the equality-transport square, combine the two adjacent functor images, and apply naturality of the last comparison at the etale compositor. Map the etale associativity equation through the final comparison functor. Naturality of the middle compositor and the fourth compositor square identify the two remaining paths. Specialize this diagram calculation to originComparisonModel and the given canonical compositors, then reflect equality through fully faithful precomposition. This retains the specified associator and Category.assoc equality transport exactly.

source.place: Tags 0F7J and 0F7K; transported along the canonical site comparison

proof.text: For a retained witness [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory], keep its same bounded-below etale object L. Apply the inverse of the canonical finite-coefficient realization equivalence to the retained alpha after the bounded-below inclusion compatibility. Prepend the unit isomorphism of the induced derived equivalence and the inverse mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. This constructs an isomorphism from comparison pullback of L to originWitnessFixedAmbient K. The witness still uses the same L and its lower-bound proof, so the required origin predicate follows, with no choice of an arbitrary witness.

source.place: Witness conjugation and retained etale-origin category; canonical coefficient equivalence
